# Support

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](SUPPORT.vi.md)

Use GitHub Issues for reproducible project defects and feature proposals. Include Python/package versions, Kaggle accelerator type, relevant endpoint, exact command, sanitized logs, and whether the failure occurs before or after model readiness.

Questions about upstream model behavior or licensing should first be checked against the corresponding upstream project and [MODEL_LICENSES.md](../MODEL_LICENSES.md).
